BEN.note: BCEAO is cited as report source only; no licensing or oversight statement for Benin.

facts.fact: Benin recorded cross-border e-money transfers within the UEMOA in 2024, per the BCEAO annual report on digital financial services.
Benin had 8 million intra-UEMOA cross-border transfer operations worth CFA 230 billion in 2024, an average of CFA 5,172, per the BCEAO.

BEN.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
Only account counts for Benin; the 73.6% inclusion rate is for the Union and no survey is named.

facts.fact: Benin had 37.5 million e-money accounts, 11.2 million active, at the end of 2024, per the BCEAO report.

Benin's e-money users made 2.54 billion transactions in 2024, including 1.8 billion merchant payments worth CFA 1,618 billion and over 200 million person-to-person transfers worth CFA 3,104 billion, per the BCEAO.

BEN.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
